name: Lightning Bolt, Greater
body:
School evocation [electricity]; Level bloodrager 4, magus 5, sorcerer/wizard 5, witch 5
Area one 120-ft line/4 levels

This spell functions as lightning bolt except the maximum is 15d6 and you can fire an additional lightning bolt per 4 caster levels. These extra bolts of lightning may be fired in any direction except directions you have already fired lightning bolts through the casting of this spell. Multiple bolts that hit the same creature due to size do not increase the damage dealt.
